name: Suki
summary: AI voice assistant that writes clinical documentation.
description: Suki listens to the visit and generates the clinical note in the health record, with voice commands for navigation. It integrates with major US EHR systems.
features: Suki is an AI product for health and medical.

howToUse.title: Sign up on Suki
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

features_fr: Suki est un produit d'IA pour la santé et le médical.
summary_fr: Assistant vocal IA qui rédige la documentation clinique.
description_fr: Suki écoute la consultation et génère la note clinique dans le dossier médical, avec des commandes vocales pour naviguer. Il s'intègre aux principaux logiciels de dossier patient américains.
